bullets.text: NFL Sunday Ticket Available Early - **YouTube TV** is offering early access to the NFL Sunday Ticket for the 2026 season.
Spotify's New Features - **Spotify** introduces 'About the Song' to provide context and trivia about tracks.
Spotify Sells Physical Books - **Spotify** expands its offerings by allowing premium users in the **UK** to buy physical books.
iOS 26 Enhancements - **Apple**'s iOS 26 introduces a redesigned Phone app with new call screening features.
SteelSeries Headphones Review - **SteelSeries**' Arctis Nova Elite headphones are praised for their premium quality and gaming performance.
AI Chipmaker Funding - **Cerebras Systems** raises $1 billion, significantly increasing its valuation amid growing AI demand.
AI in Super Bowl Ads - The 2026 Super Bowl featured **AI** prominently in commercials, sparking discussions about its role in advertising.
Roblox Age Checks - **Roblox** implements mandatory age checks to enhance child safety on its platform.
EU Targets TikTok - The **EU** demands **TikTok** disable addictive features like infinite scroll to protect users.
Apple CarPlay and AI - **Apple** is working to integrate AI chatbots like **ChatGPT** into CarPlay.
